questions.stem: In a series LCR circuit, resonance occurs at a frequency $f_0$. If the capacitance of the capacitor is made 4 times its initial value without changing the inductance, the new resonant frequency will be:
questions.solution:
The resonant frequency is given by $f_0 = \frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{LC}}$.
When $C' = 4C$, the new frequency is:
$f' = \frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{L(4C)}} = \frac{1}{2} \left(\frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{LC}}\right) = \frac{f_0}{2}$.

questions.stem: In a series LCR circuit, the resonance frequency is $200\ \mathrm{rad/s}$. If the inductance of the inductor is $5\ \mathrm{H}$ and resistance is $10\ \Omega$, the quality factor $Q$ of the circuit is _________.
questions.solution:
The quality factor of a series LCR circuit is given by $Q = \frac{\omega_0 L}{R}$.
Given $\omega_0 = 200\ \mathrm{rad/s}$, $L = 5\ \mathrm{H}$, and $R = 10\ \Omega$.
$Q = \frac{200 \times 5}{10} = 100$.

questions.stem: An AC source is rated $220\ \mathrm{V}, 50\ \mathrm{Hz}$. The average voltage of this source over any half cycle can be:
questions.solution:
The peak voltage is $V_0 = \sqrt{2} V_{\mathrm{rms}} = 220\sqrt{2}\ \mathrm{V}$.
The average voltage over a half-cycle starting from zero is $V_{\mathrm{avg}} = \frac{2V_0}{\pi} = \frac{440\sqrt{2}}{\pi}\ \mathrm{V}$. Over the other half, it is $-\frac{440\sqrt{2}}{\pi}\ \mathrm{V}$.
